items.label: Alarm off, door locked behind you until open
Walk the salon: nothing broken, wet or out of place
Lights, music and heating or air on
Starting cash counted and recorded
Point of sale and check-in screen running, online list checked
Fresh disinfectant mixed in every jar
Clean combs, guards and capes at every station
Towels stocked at stations and shampoo bowls
Retail shelves full, faced and dusted
Restroom clean and stocked, log initialled
Entry swept and door glass cleaned
Today's announcements and promos read in the portal
Door unlocked on time
Door locked at close, guests inside finished properly
End of day report run
Drawer counted, second person where possible
Deposit prepared, bag number and amount recorded
All stations, chairs and tools cleaned and disinfected
Shampoo bowls cleaned and disinfected
Whole floor swept and mopped, including under stations
Towels washed and in the dryer, none left wet
Trash emptied and bins relined
Retail and back bar restocked
Restroom cleaned
Tools, dryers and irons switched off and unplugged
Heating or air set to after-hours
Back door locked, alarm set, front door locked
Pull chairs out and clean chair bases and floor mats
Wipe baseboards and corners along every wall
Clean all mirrors edge to edge, including frames
Empty, wash and refill every disinfectant jar
Clean inside station drawers and tool holders
Descale and scrub shampoo bowls and sprayers
Clean clipper blades, oil and check for wear
Wipe retail shelves top to bottom, rotate older stock forward
Clean front desk, card reader and check-in screen
Dust light fixtures, vents and the top of shelving
Clean inside and outside of front windows and door
Clean washer filter and dryer lint trap, wipe both machines
Tidy back room: flatten boxes, organize supplies
Check first aid kit, fire extinguisher tag and exit lights
Review licences and postings are current and visible
